title: 阿戈拉隆德的欣布后继者 Simbarch of Aglarond
cn: 阿戈拉隆德的欣布后继者
body:
**阿戈拉隆德的欣布后继者 Simbarch of Aglarond**
「下辈子记着别和我作对。」

**前提条件：法师**

在她的长年统治之中，神秘的阿戈拉隆德之巫后欣布（Simbul,Witch Queen of
Aglarond）收纳了很多弟子，向他们传授她的秘法。尽管她已经不再统治阿戈拉隆德了，她的弟子们的弟子们组建了一个由被称为欣布后继者的施法者们组成的精英集团。他们保留了许多欣布的秘艺，自己也开始招收弟子。你曾经在那些从师于欣布本人的法师们手下学习过。

尽管阿戈拉隆德的的统治议会是由欣布后继者们构成的，也有一些欣布魔法的“后裔”并不是议会的成员，喜欢秘密地修习魔法。你就属于这一类。作为一名欣布后继者，你拥有成为议员的权利，但是这样做会让你承担许多重要的职责，另外还有政治上的考量。如果你决定加入议会，可能需要花费数月或甚至数年你才能被正式承认。

无论你是否成为阿戈拉隆德的领袖之一，你都会疯狂地施展让敌人吓得魂飞魄散的魔法。你的奥术能力维持并强化了你，赋予你了超人般的活力和健康。你在修习时保持着同情和克制，但是该生气的时候，你还是一个令人生畏的敌人。

**增益：**你每天获得2个额外回复力

**11级：奥法医疗 Arcane Healing**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你能同时以一个自由动作花费一次回复力

**11级：银火 Silver Fire**

⟦银火 Silver Fire⟧

⟦医疗转换 Synostodweomer⟧

title: 阿克霍西亚后裔 Scion of Arkhosia
body:
**阿克霍西亚后裔 Scion of Arkhosia**
「以艾欧之血的名义，你输定了！」

**前提条件：龙裔**

阿克霍西亚后裔是失落的阿克霍西亚帝国中，那些高尚的龙裔英雄的后代。很久以前阿克霍西亚帝国就灭亡了，而它的继承人依然散落在这个世界上。尽管在这个黑暗的年代，帝国的血脉和传统也已经变得混乱和遗失；很多龙裔甚至穷其一生都没有意识到自己潜在的能力；但是仍然有少数龙裔发掘并掌握了他们隐藏在体内的能力。

作为这些后裔之一，你已经踏上释放那来自你高尚血统中的力量的艰苦漫长的征程。你的家族比其他龙裔更加接近你们的龙族亲属。这使你你精于龙息，而且能够随意改变它的本质。

一旦你接受了这个典范之道，你将从背后生出龙一样的翅膀――作为你拥有高尚血统的最清晰的证明。它需要一些时间使变强壮，以支撑你进行短暂地爆发式地飞行。但这也清楚地标志着：你――一个新的民族英雄诞生了!

**11级：多用龙息 Versatile Breath**

**增益：**当你使用⟦龙息 Dragon Breath⟧种族威能攻击时，从下列伤害类型中选择一个：强酸，寒冰，火焰，闪电或毒素。此攻击的伤害也包括这个类型。

**11级：龙威爆发 Draconic Outburst**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行攻击时，在结算完那攻击后，每个邻近你的敌人受到等同于5 + 你体质调整值的伤害。此伤害的类型与你的⟦龙息 Dragon Breath⟧最初选择的伤害类型相同。

title: 阿克霍西亚剑圣 Arkhosian Blademaster
prerequisite: 督军，⟦阿克霍西亚尖牙学徒 <流派初成> Arkhosian Fang Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长
body:
**阿克霍西亚剑圣 Arkhosian Blademaster**
「为善而战，至死不渝！」

**前提条件：督军，⟦阿克霍西亚尖牙学徒 <流派初成> Arkhosian Fang Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长**

最后一名阿克霍西亚剑圣已经在数个世纪前逝去了，然而，那些高贵的传统依然长存在你的记忆之中，你学习着这些高贵的剑术，并且此生致力于为英勇和荣耀的理想而战。既是骑士，又是信徒，又是剑客，你是一名流浪的剑术大师和战场指挥官，寻找着那些配得上你的技艺的事业。你所遵循的剑术传统并不仅仅是用手中的长剑面对黑暗，你令周围的盟友团结起来，鼓舞他们的精神，激昂他们的斗志。

虽然旧日剑圣中的大多数都是龙裔，但是阿克霍西亚的精英卫队接纳来自各个种族的，身怀绝技且富有荣誉感的英雄们。学习阿克霍西亚古老而高贵的战斗艺术的学徒们现在来自各个种族，而不仅仅是龙裔。虽然一小撮剑圣迷失了自我，成为了雇佣兵和杀手，大多数剑圣选择隐姓埋名，屈尊在阴影中延续着他们那高贵的战斗。作为一名剑圣，无论你身穿高贵领主的华丽金铠，还是流浪骑士的结实战甲，又或是漂泊旅人的破旧斗篷，始终不变的一点就是，你反对着这世间的压迫，并随时准备与之战斗。

**11级：坚韧之刃 Resilient Blade**

**增益：**你所拥有的回复力数量增加2。

**11级：果决之动 Conclusive Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，对你具有视野线的任何盟友，在对重伤生物的伤害骰上获得等同于你的力量调整值的加值，直到你的下回合结束。

⟦挑战之吼 Shout of Challenge⟧

⟦巨龙之心 Heart of Dragons⟧

**增益：**当你使用回气时，你恢复你在本次遭遇中使用掉的等级最低的遭遇攻击威能。

title: 矮人防御者 Dwarven Defender
body:
**矮人防御者 Dwarven Defender**
「地狱的怒火无法撼动我，我却能将你锤定其位！」

**前提条件：矮人，战士**

你的族人曾挑战巨人与泰坦。团结使他们得以持续，坚韧使他们得以支撑；维护这些价值观的传统对他们大有裨益。他们像山岳般屹立不摇，面对兽人、地精和巨龙，始终不屈不挠。

矮人战士在战斗能力与相互忠诚方面无与伦比。战争传说记载，一位矮人步兵足以匹敌其他种族的两名同等技艺的战士。两位这样的战士，其价值相当于五名技艺相当的敌人。当敌军只由野蛮人组成时，矮人军队能如摧枯拉朽般轻易击溃他们。

矮人社会的所有机构都有忠于使命的士兵。勇敢的战士们为国王或领主、行会或商业、神明或教堂，或者一个简单的信条服务。少数人为了金钱，出售他们的时间与战斧以换取财富。历史悠久的战斗技巧教会了矮人战士如何最大限度地利用他们的种族能力，并运用精良的武器和坚固的盔甲。当战争的号角响起，矮人士兵坚守阵地。

你是一位矮人战斗艺术的大师，既依靠忠诚的盟友，也依赖自己的勇气和坚韧。你专精于金城汤池的防御和运筹帷幄的战术布局。你知晓如何发现并利用敌阵中的薄弱环节。盟友们视你为队伍的核心。他们从你的坚定不移和攻城略地的能力中获得信心。

**11级：防守动作 Defensive Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在AC和强韧上获得+2加值直到你下回合结束。

**11级：坚定防御者 Stalwart Defender**

**增益：**当你邻近至少一个盟友时，你与邻近的盟友在AC上获得+1加值，且所有邻近的盟友可以减少任何推离、拉近或滑动的距离1格。

title: 艾梵德拉典范 Exemplar of Avandra
body:
**艾梵德拉典范 Exemplar of Avandra**
「I am the living embodiment of Avandra's spirit.」

**前提条件：必须信仰艾梵德拉**

The life of an adventurer is a life of extremes. Although you stare death (or worse) in the face on a regular basis while serving Avandra, you also embrace everything else life has to offer.

You find joy in sharing a hearty meal in the company of friends both old and new. You hunt and fish as needed and enjoy the world around you. You delight in journeying to a previously unknown land, whether the journey is safe and quick or filled with peril. When danger draws near or when those around you are in need, you don't hesitate to spring into action, calling upon Avandra as your greatest ally. Regardless of the situation, you embrace life with unbridled confidence and optimism, and you accept the inevitable challenges you face with equanimity.

All these joys fill your heart to brimming, and you praise Avandra for the opportunity to live an adventurous life filled with beauty and peril.

**11级：典范行动 Exemplar Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你在速度，攻击骰，属性检定，和技能检定上获得+2加值，直到你下一回合结束。

**增益：**每当你使用一个移动动作快步时，你可以快步额外1格。

title: 暗星 Dark Star
body:
**暗星 Dark Star**
//

**前提条件：天族**

At 11th level, your redeemed deva takes on the dark star paragon path. Freeing oneself from corruption is no guarantee against returning to evil, and no one knows this better than does the fallen deva. Reclaiming your deva form does nothing to dispel those memories and experiences from your time as rakshasa. The wicked memories lurk in your thoughts, urging you to indulge in deviant acts, to embrace vice and wickedness, and to succumb to evil's temptation once more.

Your dark memories haunt you. Try as you might, you cannot silence the voices nor can you suppress the experiences you found in your fallen state. As you were once able, you can still call upon the memories you carry to aid you, but in addition to the other deva lifetimes, you also can draw upon your time as rakshasa as well. Drawing from these recollections places you at risk of falling once more, but provided you remain fixed toward your path, perhaps one day you will overcome the shame you must shoulder.

Devas know their redeemed brethren as dark stars, so named for their new ascendancy toward virtue and also for the evil shadowing their souls. Devas are, of course, rare in the world and so dark stars are even rarer—so scarce most might believe them representative of the entire race. As a dark star, you must ever contend with your unpleasant memories while working to earn the redemption you have received.

**11级：恐慌行动 Horrifying Action**

When you push yourself, your extra effort interferes with your ability to tamp down on the darkness within you. Enemies near you glimpse what you once were and recoil in horror.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你可以在此回合使用一次⟦千世遥忆 Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes⟧而不消耗其使用，即使你已经在此遭遇中使用过它。所有在你花费行动点时邻近你的敌人不能对你进行借机攻击，直到你下一回合开始。

**11级：狂乱妄想 Maddening Delusion**

When you lived as a rakshasa, you used every means at your disposal to feed your unholy appetites. In calling upon your memories to aid in your attacks, old habits assert themselves and plague an enemy with unspeakable hallucinations.

**增益：**当你在攻击检定中使用⟦千世遥忆 Memory of a Thousand Lifetimes⟧并且此攻击命中时，目标在攻击骰上受到-2减值且提供战斗优势，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：痛苦移位 Excruciating Transposition**

The moment you fell, dark forces gifted you with strange powers over time and space. Although you have traveled far from that life, you can still call upon those gifts to protect yourself against an enemy's attack.

⟦痛苦移位 Excruciating Transposition⟧

**12级：纠缠命运 Tangled Fate**

Fate bows to your wishes. The corrupted memories violate the natural order and twist outcomes to your advantage.

⟦纠缠命运 Tangled Fate⟧

**16级：邪恶重生 Vile Rebirth**

Evil powers rail against your virtue and tempt you with gifts and offerings to lure you back to their embrace. These forces are so powerful, they won’t let your mortal body die.

**增益：**每天一次，当你进行死亡豁免时，你可以在掷骰后在此豁免检定上+10。然后，直到遭遇结束，你失去光耀抗力。

**20级：游魂之祸 Soul Scourge**

You release the mingled light and darkness found in your soul in one brilliant burst. After the light fades and your enemies' wails for their burned souls die down, you remain while shadows and light dance around you.

⟦游魂之祸 Soul Scourge⟧

title: 暗影上校 Shadow Captain

title: 翱翔浪子 Soaring Rake
prerequisite: 精类起源，半精灵，「精类契约」邪术师或⟦精类盟约 Fey Bond⟧专长；在杂技上受训
body:
**翱翔浪子 Soaring Rake**
//

**前提条件：精类起源，半精灵，「精类契约」邪术师或⟦精类盟约 Fey Bond⟧专长；在杂技上受训**

All realms see their share of swashbuckling types, whose love for freedom and a happy-go-lucky attitude belie their combat prowess. But the Feywild has given rise to a particularly exotic type of swashbuckler, whose fighting style defies gravity. These daring adventurers are known as soaring rakes.

Soaring rakes gain their uncanny abilities through a variety of paths, though each has a profound link to the Feywild, either from being born in that realm or through a direct connection to one of the Feywild powers (such as being a fey pact warlock or having the Fey Bond feat). This connection to the Feywild and its ambient magic allows soaring rakes to take to the skies at will. Due to the added element of flight, soaring rakes develop a unique fighting style, and many consider them the ultimate skirmishers.

Most soaring rakes have an outlook on life that mimics their abilities. Problems, dangers, and frustrations affect them less than most, since the rakes can take to the air and leave their worries behind them. In keeping with their carefree attitude, the vast majority of soaring rakes turn to Avandra for worship, trusting in the god of luck to see them through any challenge.

**11级：无惧高空 Fear No Heights**

Your flying abilities manifest subconsciously whenever you fall, slowing you enough to reduce the damage you might take.

**增益：**你在杂技检定上获得+2加值，且你只从坠落中受到一半伤害。

**11级：高飞行动 Soaring Action**

When you put forth your greatest effort, you can fly through the air, carried aloft by your determination.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点时，你获得等同于你速度的飞行速度直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：翱翔之击 Soaring Strike**

Although it takes some effort, you have mastered the technique of melding short flights with powerful strikes.

⟦翱翔之击 Soaring Strike⟧

**12级：飞行爆发 Flight Burst**

With minimal effort, you take flight like a Feywild sprite. Tiny motes of glowing dust trail behind you, a clue to the magical source of your abilities.

⟦飞行爆发 Flight Burst⟧

**16级：翱翔战士 Soaring Combatant**

Your ability to fly increases your maneuverability, making it difficult for land-bound foes and clumsy fliers to avoid your attacks.

**增益：**你对没有飞行速度或拥有飞行（笨拙）速度的敌人的近战伤害骰上获得+2加值。

**20级：翱翔之友谊 Soaring Fellowship**

You draw fully upon the Feywild’s ambient magic to deliver a mighty strike to an enemy. While the magic flows through you, you extend your magical nature to your companions, and your entire company takes to the air like a flock of birds.

⟦翱翔之友谊 Soaring Fellowship⟧

title: 奥法诡徒 Arcane Trickster
body:
**奥法诡徒 Arcane Trickster**
「我的技巧来自工具和法术。」

**前提条件：游荡者，在神秘上受训**

You've never been content to stick to one path. Magic and larceny, spell and trap, dweomer and shadow—for you, all came easy. You learned to fuse your knowledge into one style, both in and out of battle.

When you were a child, you dreamed of grand achievements. You enjoyed the shows of illusionists and magicians, and you reveled in the skill of pickpockets and burglars. You followed two divergent paths that eventually came together in your mind as a way of life and a cohesive style of attack. You don't separate the martial from the magical, and you are mildly scornful of anyone who is so shortsighted as to make this division.

You never sought a position in an arcane order or a thieves' guild; you didn't want to limit yourself. Instead, you learned to recognize that each adventure is an opportunity to test your mettle, sharpen your skills, enhance your magic, and discover treasures

Eladrin are naturals for this path because of their agility and keen intellect. Arcane tricksters are found among gnomes, changelings, and drow as well. Some use their knowledge and power for adventure, and others use it for theft, torture, and deception.

**11级：奥法窃贼 Arcane Burglary**

**增益：**你能将匕首作为法器使用。不过你在使用匕首进行法器攻击时，不会获得它的擅长加值。

另外，当你进行运动检定时，你可以使用神秘技能调整值代替运动技能调整值。

**11级：褪色行动 Fading Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次攻击时，由你选择的你攻击的一个生物将你视作隐形（豁免终止）。

**11级：致盲之火 Blinding Flare**

⟦致盲之火 Blinding Flare⟧

**12级：飞贼之幕 Cat Burglar's Veil**

**增益：**在使用匕首作为法器进行一次奥术攻击时，你可以将远程威能视作具有近战武器射程。

**20级：混淆传送 Confounding Teleport**

⟦混淆传送 Confounding Teleport⟧

title: 奥法猎手 Arcane Hunter
prerequisite: 剑法师，⟦诱捕庇护 Aegis of Ensnarement⟧职业特性
body:
**奥法猎手 Arcane Hunter**
「我的刀锋之下，万物皆为齑粉，抵抗皆为徒劳」

**前提条件：剑法师，⟦诱捕庇护 Aegis of Ensnarement⟧职业特性**

你擅长从敌人的防御中发现弱点，避实击虚。在面对依赖自然抵抗力的生物时，奥法感官会让你获得优势。

作为一名奥法猎手，你可能从小开始就已经接受训练，仅凭视觉就能识别生物的弱点。在那之后，你受到的魔法教育进一步完善了这些技能，让你可以利用不可见的能量触须发现敌人的破绽。

从学习和冒险中，你发现面对不同敌人，适应性是最好的特质之一。与其专精一种攻击或伤害类型，你宁愿有更多选择。

**11级：洞察打击 Knowing Strike**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次攻击时，这次攻击无视所有抗力和虚体特性。

**11级：完美打击 Perfect Strike**

**增益：**每当你造成重击，你的攻击造成等于目标最高易伤值的额外伤害。

**11级：尽察弱点 Exploit Weakness**

⟦尽察弱点 Exploit Weakness⟧

**12级：元素架势 Elemental Stance**

⟦元素架势 Elemental Stance⟧

**16级：尽察之眼 Exploitive Eye**

**增益：**当攻击具有一种或多种抗力的生物时，你将这些抗力视为比原来的数值低10（最低0）。

**20级：弱点打击 Flaw Seeking Strike**

⟦弱点打击 Flaw Seeking Strike⟧

title: 奥法骑士 Eldritch Knight
prerequisite: 战士（骑士），在神秘上受训
body:
**奥法骑士 Eldritch Knight**

**前提条件：战士（骑士），在神秘上受训**

当你达到第11级时，你的魔法训练与你的军事专长融合在一起。你现在可以将奥术能量转化为有用的攻击。在其他骑士可能选择坚定骑士之路的地方，你会找到另一条路，引导你完善你不同寻常的风格，击败敌人的野望。你可以加入星光之城的剑卫来磨练你的技术，也可以走自己的路，通过试错来学习你的技术。不管你是如何获得这些能力的，结果都是魔法和钢铁的致命融合，直到你成为一名能够抵御任何敌人的奥法骑士。

**11级：多元研究 Diversified Study**

The epiphany resulting from your study in the arcane arts puts true magic into your hands. In effect, you can shape arcane magic into spells.

**增益：**你获得一个7级或更低等级的法师遭遇攻击威能。你可以在此攻击中使用一个你持用的近战武器作为法器。将武器的增强加值（如果有的话）加到你的攻击骰和伤害骰上。但是你不能在此攻击骰上获得你的擅长加值

**11级：魔能诱导 Eldritch Abduction**

When you make a hasty retreat, you can bring along another creature. Sometimes you might do so to draw an ally out of danger. Other times, you might use it to set up an offensive.

**增益：**每当你在你的⟦防御者灵气 Defender Aura⟧激活时传送，你可以传送一个在灵气内的自愿生物到邻近你此移动结束的一个未被占据的格子。你不能传送此生物进入妨害地形

**11级：遥步延伸 Far Step Extension**

You seize magical energy and coax greater power from it to close the gap to a distant foe.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你可以在进行此额外动作之前或之后以一个自由动作传送最多等同于你智力调整值的格子

**12级：奥法之跃 Eldritch Leap**

Your extensive study in the arcane arts reveals the existence of hidden pathways through space. You can leap from one location to another in the blink of an eye.

⟦奥法之跃 Eldritch Leap⟧

**16级：魔能之刃 Eldritch Blade**

You release magic across the length of your weapon to meet your enemy with full and lethal force.

**增益：**每当你在使用借机动作时以近战武器攻击命中，则其伤害无视目标可能拥有的虚体或任何抗力

**20级：魔能孤立 Eldritch Isolation**

You bring to bear the full technique of your fighting style when you perform your signature strike.

**增益：**当你使用⟦强力打击 Power Strike⟧时，你和你的目标都传送最多5格到你选择的彼此邻近的格子。你不能在传送结束时使你或目标进入妨害地形

title: 奥法泉源 Arcane Wellspring
body:
**奥法泉源 Arcane Wellspring**
「我不在乎它为何生效。我只知道它真的生效了。」

**前提条件：术士**

奥法之力在所有术士的体内流动，它是他们与生俱来的一部分。但对你而言，这力量就像地面之下的喷泉，在它爆发出毁灭、壮观的力量前的样子。你与它的连结总是轻而易举，几乎是种本能。它缓慢地但改变你如此之深，使你的血肉与灵魂充塞着你所引导的力量。

当你行於奥能泉源之道上时，你精通了第二种伤害类型。你习得了能同时引导两种伤害类型的法术，或使那流转的奥术能量围绕在你身旁。最後，你获得将自己短时间化为奥术能量的能力。

**11级：双重抗力 Double Resistance**

**增益：**如果你拥有「巨龙魔法」，则为你的「巨龙之魂」职业特性选择第二种伤害类型。如果你拥有「狂野魔法」，则在每次长休息后，为你的「狂野之魂」职业特性掷两次d10（如果你第二次掷出相同的结果，则重掷）。无论你拥有哪个「法术本源」，你获得这两种伤害类型的抗力，而且你的奥术威能无视目标对这两种伤害类型的部分抗力，最高无视等同于你的抗力的数值。

**11级：法术分裂 Split Spell Action**

**增益：**当你使用一个通常只有一个目标的奥术威能时，你可以花费一个行动点来指定一个额外的生物为目标，而不是进行额外动作。

⟦术法之翼 Sorcerous Wings⟧

**增益：**当你使用一个区域或近程的奥术威能时，在结算此攻击前，你可以传送被此攻击命中的两个生物，使它们互换位置。

title: 奥法之剑 Sorcerous Sword
body:
**奥法之剑 Sorcerous Sword**

**前提条件：法师（剑咏士）**

Your explorations into magic and swordplay set you on a path of heightened magical ability. Yet as you pursue arcane might, you strive to maintain a balance between it and the might of steel.

**11级：剑之合奏 Choir of Swords**

In your most desperate moments, bladesinging can give you a clarity of vision and such superior speed that your sword seems to become several blades, each a separate singer in a choir of swords.

**增益：**在你的⟦剑歌 Bladesong⟧生效期间，你可以花费一个行动点以一个标准动作对邻近你的每个敌人进行一次近战基本攻击

**11级：恩惠法术 Boon Spell**

Magic comes ever easier to you as you continue your studies. You now acquire another prepared spell as easily as adding an arrow to a quiver.

**增益：**你选择1个7级或更低的新法师遭遇攻击威能加入到你的法术书里，且这个威能对你来说视为每日威能。

另外，每天你能从你的法术书里准备1个额外剑咏士每日威能。此额外威能可以和你准备的另一个威能等级相同，但此特性不能让你在同一天准备同一个威能两次

**12级：剑歌芭蕾 Bladesong Ballet**

The bladesong has always been a dance, but now your movement as your sword sings has an elegance and deftness that defies the mind's grasp.

**增益：**在你的⟦剑歌 Bladesong⟧生效期间，你能以一个移动动作快步最多等于你速度的格数

**16级：剑法术之步 Bladespell Step**

Your connection to arcane magic opens a path for you that is closed to all others. One moment you strike a foe with a sword, and the next you stand many strides away.

**增益：**每遭遇一次，在你使用一个剑法术威能之后你可以立即以一个自由动作传送最多5格

**20级：大师猎人 Master Hunter**

Just as a duelist might have a unique flourish, you develop an especially formidable special arcane attack that serves as your signature.

**增益：**你获得1个19级或更低的法师每日攻击威能

title: 奥术行者 Arcane Wayfarer
body:
**奥术行者 Arcane Wayfarer**
「距离仅仅是一个幻觉，一个被物质世界所束缚的精神概念。」

**前提条件：法师**

时间与空间对大多数人来说都是一种束缚。只有神、本源、传奇才能够突破这种桎梏，此外或许还有凡人，比如你。

你已经掌握了不少可以瞬间在两地间旅行的方法。但此刻，作为一名奥术行者，你对传送背后的运作原理有了更深入的认识。随着知识的增长，借由纯粹的精神力而非肌肉，传送对你来说如同散步般自然、简单。这种知识并不局限于自身，你同样善于用各种空间效果来影响他人，比如将盟友送至安全之处，或将敌人丢入危险之境。

虽然时间依旧超出你的掌握，但至少你已然证明了空间并非如常人所想的那般不可逾越。实际上，两点之间的最短距离有时候并非只是那简单的一条直线。

**增益：**当你的法师攻击威能造成重击时，你同时可以传送4格。

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你同时可以用一个自由动作传送4格。

title: 奥术装甲官 Arcane Armorer
prerequisite: 机关术士，⟦治疗注射：防护合剂 Healing Infusion: Shielding Elixir⟧威能
body:
**奥术装甲官 Arcane Armorer**
「The wards I've placed on your armor should provide you
with all the protection you need.」

**前提条件：机关术士，⟦治疗注射：防护合剂 Healing Infusion: Shielding Elixir⟧威能**

Arcane armorers are skilled artificers who havefocused their knowledge on enhancing the defensivecapabilities of their allies. Many arcane armorerscombine their knowledge of armorsmithing withtheir skill with the arcane arts, augmenting theirallies' defenses in a way that others cannot.

Arcane armorers are especially talented at weaving enchantments over their allies' armor that notonly enhances the armor but also turns the ally intoa walking weapon. Arcane armorers can use theenergy they imbue into an ally's armor as a methodof delivering powerful spell charges at their enemies.Similarly, arcane armorers use their allies' armor asanchors, connecting enemies to their allies, drainingenergy from one to boost the other.

As an arcane armorer, you focus your efforts onturning your allies into your magic weapons out onthe battlefield. You want your allies to move up closeto the enemies you face, protecting them from afarwhile using them to deliver your own attacks. Whenyour allies are in trouble, you shield them from further danger, or pull them back from the front lines.

body:
**奥战大师 Arcane Battlemaster**
「战场，和炼金术差不多，一切都是元素的组合。」

**前提条件：督军，在神秘上受训**

Since you first took up arms, you have felt a kinship with wizards, because, like them, you're at your best when your natural talents are honed by careful study. While young wizards were studying the elements and energy of the multiverse, you were studying tactics, especially the strategies that employ magic as a weapon of war. The presence of a powerful mage changes the entire dynamic of a typical battle, and you have worked long and hard to familiarize yourself with exactly how such a weapon can be employed or defended against.

As part of your study of war magic, you have mastered a small amount of magic yourself. However, you realize your full potential when you're leading dedicated spellcasters and putting their powers to good use.

title: 白角骑士 White Horn Knight
body:
**白角骑士 White Horn Knight**
//

**前提条件：擅长重甲**

Eachthighern (pronounced "Whitehorn"), the Lord of Unicorns, is one of the most respected archfey in the Court of Stars. His wisdom is valued and respected by Queen Tiandra, and rival archfey such as Baba Yaga begrudgingly acknowledge his strength. Unlike most other archfey, Eachthighern takes mortal heroes as his personal knights and sends them forth to stamp out evil creatures wherever they are found.

When Eachthighern needs a new knight, he sends a herald to one of his choices. These heralds are usually eladrin bards, but sometimes he assigns this duty to more exotic fey such as centaurs or unicorns. The herald transports the prospective knight to the Serene Glade, where Eachthighern makes his offer. If the person refuses the offer, Eachthighern is saddened but respects the candidate's wishes. The herald then takes the person back, but this former candidate loses the memories of the audience thanks to the use of a special type of oblivion moss. If the candidate accepts the offer, the Lord of Unicorns touches the person with his horn, in a manner similar to a king knighting a squire. If the newly accepted knight desires it, he or she receives Eachthighern's heraldic symbol of a unicorn rampant in a field of deep blue, but such displays aren't mandatory because Feywild natives instinctively recognize Lord Eachthighern's mark upon the knight.

A White Horn knight's quests include anything from rescuing slaves from fomorian holds to guiding travelers safely through dangerous woodlands plagued by mad dryads, sly verbeeg, or ferocious owlbears. The knights count evil fey such as lamias and hags as their greatest opponents, because these creatures often hunt unicorns for their hearts and horns, which such dark fey use in their horrid rituals.

A White Horn knight is blessed with some of the Lord of Unicorns' power and gains the service of a loyal unicorn steed. The knight's abilities mark the character as a valiant leader in the fight against evil. Though most White Horn knights pay ultimate homage to their lord, some also serve Corellon.

**11级：独角兽行动 Unicorn's Action**

When you push yourself to the limit, you channel the healing power of a unicorn to heal yourself or an ally.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你或一个邻近你的盟友恢复等同于5 + 你力量或魅力调整值的生命值。

**11级：独角兽行军 Unicorn's Advance**

Using quick bursts of teleportation, you can sidestep difficult terrain to close the gap on your enemies.

**增益：**你在冲锋时无视困难地形。如果你骑乘你的⟦独角兽战马 Unicorn Destrier⟧时冲锋，则它共享此增益

**11级：独角兽之血 Unicorn's Blood**

The blessings of Eachthighern strengthen your body.

**增益：**你在对抗遭受疾病和毒素效果的豁免检定上获得+2加值。如果你骑乘你的⟦独角兽战马 Unicorn Destrier⟧，则它共享此增益

**11级：狂热暂歇 Fierce Respite**

You channel your sense of honor and commitment to justice into a single weapon attack that cuts down one enemy even as it heals a nearby ally.

⟦狂热暂歇 Fierce Respite⟧

**12级：呼唤独角兽战马 Call Unicorn Destrier**

Once you have proven yourself, Lord Eachthighern deems you fit to receive his most precious gift: a unicorn destrier. Through a specialized spell, you part the barrier between your current location and the Serene Glade, calling forth a unicorn to serve you.

⟦呼唤独角兽战马 Call Unicorn Destrier⟧

**16级：幽雅静谧 Graceful Serenity**

The trust placed upon you by Lord Eachthighern gives you greater confidence to face each new battle. Allies that stand beside you are encouraged by your serenity in the face of dangerous foes.

**增益：**在战斗的突袭轮和第一轮时，你在所有防御上获得+2加值。你的盟友在邻近你时同样获得此加值

**20级：独角兽之赐 Blessing of Unicorns**

At your behest, the planar veil parts, allowing you to receive the blessing of unicorns from Lord Eachthighern's forested realm. The majestic creatures trample your enemies and heal your allies before crossing back through the veil to their home.

⟦独角兽之赐 Blessing of Unicorns⟧

title: 白金督军 Platinum Warlord
prerequisite: 督军，善良或守序善良阵营
body:
**白金督军 Platinum Warlord**
「Those who favor peace at all costs are noble, but misguided. Sometimes battle is the only righteous choice.」

**前提条件：督军，善良或守序善良阵营**

Bahamut requires his devotees to protect the innocent and the weak. Those who revere the Platinum Dragon are ever watchful for the rise of evil, and in particular the followers of Tiamat. Negotiation with Tiamat's forces is rarely useful and often fatal. The tenets of justice also require adherents of Bahamut's faith to oppose injustice and despotism. Although the metallic dragon god is a lover of peace, his laws regularly require battles and crusades.

Many valiant folk who serve Bahamut are paladins or clerics. But Bahamut spurns no noble soul's offer of service. Even those without divine investiture have a place in the effort to bring Bahamut's light to theworld's gloomy places. Secular leaders who venerate Bahamut lend power to the Platinum Dragon's cause by ensuring order, honor, and justice in worldly institutions.

Temples dedicated to honorable battle invariably include Bahamut among the gods respected. Such places teach techniques and values aimed at bringing virtue to the world by example rather than by exhortation. Those sent to learn are often warriors or nobles bound for a nation's military.

Perhaps you came to Bahamut through such schooling. Other good-hearted people find the Platinum Dragon's ways through personal devotion or study, or even providence. Bahamut willingly instills a small measure of divine grace in those who show true commitment. Your heroic deeds and pure heart have proven you to be worthy of Bahamut's blessing. So you carry Bahamut's mark, using his minor gifts to protect, heal, and shine forth as a model of justice.

**白金圣堂武士 Platinum Templar**
吾辈之众，各选一方，何以神志清明之身立于妒忌、复仇、贪婪之处？

title: 白鸦 White Raven
body:
**白鸦 White Raven**
「领袖的伟大取决于他的士兵。」

**前提条件：督军**

You are a renowned captain and a famous leader who is known for generosity toward your troops and ferocity in the face of enemies. You're at your best with allies nearby, fighting back to back against a throng of worthy foes. You grew up in a culture that values camaraderie, honor, cooperation, and nobility. Dirty fighting, deceit, and trickery are anathema to you. You eschew these strategies in favor of sound tactics, strong morale, well-trained warriors, solid armor and weapons, and proper planning. You're not afraid to get your hands dirty, though you believe that respect should be shown to friend and foe alike.

Not everyone has what it takes to be a white raven. You must be mindful of the needs of your allies, the honor of your foes, and your legacy in years to come. You hope to earn your place in the courts of the gods, and you know that such a place is not reached without effort. You plan to do whatever it takes to be worthy of such an honor.

White raven is often a hereditary title akin to nobility in military societies. Despite this tradition, you didn't achieve this rank without proving your skill, valor, and generosity to those older and more experienced in battle and in the ways of the world. You have been given a great honor by having this title bestowed upon you. If you were to die tomorrow, you would be content knowing that you have lived your life to the best of your ability.

**败亡灾兽 Blightbeast**
「你的死期便是他人的活路。」

**前提条件：德鲁伊**

死亡与腐朽也和诞生与生命一样，都是自然的一部分。尽管许多德鲁伊拥护生命与健康的自然，但也有少数投身于自然的黑暗面，将他们自己沉浸于残酷的需要中，而这就像诞生在自然循环中一样扮演着重要的角色。像其他德鲁伊一样，他们猛烈地保护精魂和自然不受伤害，但他们使用自然中最黑暗的元素来作为武器对付他们的敌人

成为败亡灾兽，你认同了这些凶恶的元素，并体现出死亡。你使用的力量可能会体现在你的类人形态外貌上。或者你可能将你与死亡的亲密关系隐藏起来，直到你采用野兽形态，那是你真正的本性就揭露出来了

你可能是个冷酷无情的杀手。这样你可以利用你的新力量为新的生命腾出空间。你可以用你的力量来摧毁那些威胁自然之人，或者致力于消灭自然秩序的敌人。你的力量对非自然生物和自然生物都同样有效。

「无论好坏，战神指引着我的命运。」

The realm of mortals is the battlefield of the gods. Forbidden to manifest their power directly, the gods rely on intermediaries to fight their battles. Some heroes volunteer their strength to this divine cause, but not you. Your training taught you how to wield a weapon, not a holy symbol, and to place your faith in your armor and your own courage. As a warrior of outstanding courage and skill, you have caught the attention of Bane, the god of war, and his heavy gaze lies upon your battles and quests.

Some who fall under Bane's gaze embrace their role as paragons of war, serving the Black Hand willingly. You are not bound to this fate. Bane is a terrible tyrant, yet he has great admiration for mortals who excel in martial virtues such as discipline, courage, and skill at arms. Above all, Bane is delighted by victory. A hero who battles for good and eschews tyranny might oppose what Bane stands for, but if he or she is brave, skillful, and triumphant, the master of war is darkly pleased even in defeat.

**半身人好汉 Halfling Scoundrel**
「越大越笨！」

**前提条件：半身人**

半身人的传说中最伟大的英雄是那些战胜巨人、恶龙或是其它威胁他们家园的人，他们胆大心细，机智幽默。他们无需厚重的铠甲和传奇的宝剑，亦没有封地和贵族的名号。他们都是普通的半身人――敢于接受挑战，证明力量和体型并非成功的必须品。你就是他们中的一员。

你就像所有半身人一样，发现在这个充满了大型生物的世界中生存的最好方式就是避免和他们冲突。这似乎意味着必须远离他们的视线或是和他们站在一起。这样可以躲在他们够不到的地方，或是闪开他们的攻击。隐秘和诡计本身或许并非武器和盔甲，但却可以提供最好的补充。无畏和决心，足够你战胜任何敌人――无论他块头多大。

相较于传说中英雄的种族，你更像一个混混。但实际上，你的狡猾机智使你不逊于任何一位英雄。艾梵德拉赐予了你接受挑战、解决问题的勇气和智慧，以及生存所需的隐秘。

title: 半身人速刃 Halfling Quickblade
body:
**半身人速刃 Halfling Quickblade**
「我告诉过你，伙计。我有的是最快的刀。这不是吹牛，这是真的。」

**前提条件：半身人，游荡者**

Halflings have a long tradition of using light blades with great skill. Whether a tool of survival or an implement of battle, the simple dagger has much to recommend it. Even one as small as a halfling can hide a dagger on the body for use in a tight spot.A small body coupled with a small weapon means greater mobility and deadliness enhanced by a better chance for stealthy attacks.

Halflings also have a history of using light blades in their art and performances. Carving, acrobatic blade tricks, knife juggling, dagger throwing, and even dances that incorporate blades are common among halflings. For them, such activities are a natural meeting of physical traits and handy tools.

As with almost every other aspect of their life, halflings have a variety of stories that explain their propensity for using blades. Such yarns include the daring tales of Barras Quickblade, whose surname is probably one of convenient fiction.

Barras's legend begins when he was a lad who provided for his clan by stalking game with nothing but a knife and his wits. The legend grows into a spirited saga of an adventurous halfling who, along with a band of other intrepid characters, confronts ogres, yuan-ti, and worse with a tongue as pointed as his blade.

In the end, most stories have it that Barras sacrificed himself to save his comrades by leading a group of fomorians on a reckless chase through the Feywild. Darker versions say that Barras's spirit is still trapped, kept prisoner by the twisted fey. Halflings prefer to think that he passed from the world and that he stands at Avandra's side as her immortal companion.

body:
**半身人纵跃者 Halfling Bounder**
「让我的体型愚弄你，这将是你最后的失误。」

**前提条件：半身人，战士**

凡界广阔而充斥着野性，而游牧的半身人却是小体型的民族。尽管如此，他们的灵巧和急智仍然让他们幸存了下来。就像他们一直在做的那样，他们将结果归结于依靠灵巧而且大胆的战士来守护他们。甚至于安排半身人保存一个类似军人的职业以负责他们在其他的、更大的文明种族中的利益。

半身人纵跃者的战斗传统有利于半身人的特性。纵跃者练习游斗的策略和集群战术。他们跃进战场，消除更大体型敌人的攻击，从意外的角度打击并且进行骚扰性的突袭。纵跃者心甘情愿的付出他们的生命，以让他们保护的人幸存并逃离危险。

大多数游牧半身人氏族拥有大量的纵跃者，他们在氏族中充当侦查员。这些战士帮助氏族保持旅行的无忧无虑-他们总是在威胁变得可怕之前就将危险平息。具有才能和这种意向的半身人可以轻松地获悉纵跃者的技术。一部分战士将这种专长用在半身人地区之外，在守护朋友和普通民众的同时，满足他们对于自然的好奇心。

你就是一个这样的半身人民族的守卫。你手执闪光的剑刃纵身四周，嘲笑那些设法停止你却因为拙劣的动作而被绊倒的大傻瓜。你学习过如何用你的小体型从不同的角度观察战斗，以使你能够轻松地发现其他人露出的破绽，然后用每个在战斗中得到的好处狩猎你的敌人。如果你的技能因为某种原因提升较少，你可以用你的幸运弥补它。

title: 暴力执行者 Strong-Arm Enforcer
body:
**暴力执行者 Strong-Arm Enforcer**
「This is going to hurt you a lot more than it hurts me.」

**前提条件：游荡者，在威吓上受训**

The world has no shortage of bullies. In every town and every neighborhood roams a lout with more muscle than sense, and more bravado than backbone. Every gang has an enforcer or a leg breaker. Yet it takes more than a mean streak and a hard head to rise above mere thuggery.

Unlike such roughnecks, who are so often craven at heart, you have cold iron beneath your hardened visage. You have the skill and the mettle to make good on threats you offer. Intimidation, to you, is just fair warning, an omen foretelling the cost of crossing you.

Like most of your kind, you might have started with a criminal outfit or learned how to get along in the harsh training ground of the streets. Such unsavory surroundings taught you to survive. A reputation for handing out grim rewards to your enemies slowly enabled you to avoid fights through the use of your bladed stare. For a few of you, formal training as an interrogator or operative taught you to use fear and pain as a principal means of getting the job done. In any case, fear is as useful in battle as it is outside it.

You have set your mind to this harsh fact and have realized that most interactions are all about getting in and getting out on top. If the other guy believes you can and will hurt him if you need to, dealings are much more likely to go in your favor.

Although stealth and subterfuge have uses, combat isn't a subtle solution. You favor techniques that keep your enemies shaken. A traumatized, fearful, or angry foe is more likely to make a mistake. Encouraging such missteps—gleefully at times—you make yourself a target through your brutality. Then you and your allies capitalize on those slip-ups to win the day.

「小心？谨慎？不！在战斗中直面敌人然后站在他残破的尸体上，这才叫勇气。」

怒火使你心烦意乱，你必须进攻――预先计划的行动与精密的战术不过是消遣罢了。你以势不可挡的攻击在群敌之中穿梭，或把一名敌人困在致命的交互攻击中――而它只会以另一人的死亡作为结末。当你陷入战斗的狂热中，你忽略痛苦并在其他人倒下之时继续战斗。你是无可阻挡的毁灭风暴。

**暴雪法师 Blizzard Mage**
「冬天冻结肉体，用刺骨的寒风冲刷大地，冷风呼啸着穿过树篱和山岳。我想不出还有什么比这更有诗意的了。」

title: 奔雷铁骑 Lightning Blitzer
body:
**奔雷铁骑 Lightning Blitzer**
「荣誉感召着我疾驰而至。」

**前提条件：半兽人，牧师或圣武士**

You grew up in a tribe that valued speed in battle, to the point that none would wear any armor heavier than a leather vest, or perhaps a hide cuirass. When you came of age, you saw the downsides of this strategy. Swift warriors found that their enemies' blades were just a little swifter. You challenged the orthodoxy of the tribe, favoring heavier and heavier armor. Your tribe mocked you, for with your protection, you found you could no longer keep up with the rest of the tribe in battle and would inevitably fall behind your comrades as they claimed glory. Some murmured that you wore the armor so that you would not have to fight and risk your life.

You would not be known as a coward, so you went on a pilgrimage in honor of your deity. You wanted to prove your bravery and seek an answer to your problem—the balance of defense and agility. When you reached your goal, tired and worn, you did not ask the gods for answers: You demanded them. You had shown your strength and proven your courage. A blessing from the gods was the only just reward for your exploits. A storm raged about you, and as you finished your demands, lightning struck you. Many gods would have killed you for your effrontery, but perhaps you pleased your patron with your attitude. You awoke later, unharmed, and you knew your prayers were answered.

Many of your tribe had already written you off as dead when you began your pilgrimage, and they were astounded to see you return. You would not tell them what happened, preferring once again to prove yourself through your deeds. When next the tribe went into battle, they were surprised as you kept speed with the other warriors, and amazed when you fell upon your enemies, your every blow ringing out with the power of the storm.

title: 崩山投掷者 Avalanche Hurler
body:
**崩山投掷者 Avalanche Hurler**
「Go ahead, keep making fun of me. I don't need a bow to hit you from down here.」

**前提条件：游侠**

The first avalanche hurlers were dwarf slaves in the ancient realms of the giants. Tempered by suffering and endless labor, and without access to soldierly methods, these dwarves tailored their ways of fighting to their work tools. They developed martial techniques that allowed them to be flexible in combat. A rebel needs ranged capability to kill in ambushes and slay retreating adversaries. Skill in melee is required to stand up to larger and quicker foes.

Revolutionary dwarves took up their hammers and axes. They threw these tools into the faces of their oppressors. Then, hammering and hewing from underfoot, the first avalanche hurlers brought their outsized masters down and escaped to the wilderness. They settled in underground halls they cut for themselves, places too small for their enemies to invade. Dwarves then made war on giants in Moradin's name.

Dwarf clans have maintained the avalanche hurler fighting style across the generations. They preserve their earliest original combat style, but they never held it so sacred that they failed to give it to allies among all sorts of folk. Further, the avalanche hurler might have been originally recorded in dwarven folklore, but other races developed similar military methods independently.

As an ever resourceful avalanche hurler, you are effective both in close combat and at range. Rather than mastering one ranger fighting style, you embrace both, using thrown melee weapons as your chosen instruments of death. What you lose in range and damage, you make up for with your versatility, being able to make attacks against adjacent enemies and then send your weapons flying against those beyond your reach.

body:
**边疆统帅 Borderlands Marshal**
「我发现了这敌人的防御弱点；交给你了」

**前提条件：督军，⟦荒野战士 <兼职游侠> Warrior of the Wild <Multiclass Ranger>⟧兼职专长**

Survival in the bloody frontier lands follows a savage code without the niceties of honorable engagement. Your experiences in the world's darker conflicts have pushed you to a pragmatism that other warriors may lack—react fast, or die. If you can strike first, you will. If you miss, you aim your blows to push your enemies into your allies' blades. And when your allies find a way to strike your enemies by surprise, you anticipate and aid their actions.

Some might say that your methods are haphazard and desperate. They may be right, but as far as you can tell, desperate efforts are exactly what's required.

Walking unseen among a thankless populace are agents of the Unbroken Circle—a unity of avengers in service to the goddess Erathis. Each agent is sworn to root out and destroy forces that foul the goodness of mortal hearts. They wage a constant war against growing evil, defending civilization and the honor of Nerath from the closing jaws of tyranny and corruption.

As an agent of the Unbroken Circle, you take on corruption wherever you find it—and since you actively look for it, you find a great deal of it. Whether you're based in a population center and spend most of your time there or travel far afield in search of those who have fallen morally and ethically, you rely on your skills as an avenger and the ones you gain as an agent to handle combat situations and provide support to those with whom you travel. Due to your constant vigilance for signs of corruption, you have found few you can trust, and you always formulate an escape plan in every situation, just in case the ones you rely upon fail you.

A foulborn's life is a difficult one, and no one knows this better than you. You have carried the Far Realm's burden within you for more years than you can count. You long ago came to terms with your corruption, adapting to the unsightly transformation you were forced to endure. In doing so, you discovered ways to make the curse work for you. Many years spent testing your capabilities revealed unexpected advantages that help you exceed your normal limitations, enabling you not only to survive but to thrive.

Reflection and understanding do not come without a price, however. The more you draw on your corrupted power, the greater its effect on you and the more unhinged your mind becomes. This state of being lends itself to strange delusions and compulsions, but the power you gain is worth it. 「吾之职责是令恶狼远离羊群，吾将尽力而为。」

**前提条件：神罚使**

隐秘的戒律和神秘的仪式是大多数神罚使的入会方式，然而你遵循着一种更为简朴的传统。你是平民的守护者，但却寄身于常人的视野之外。借助安静的风格和智慧的信仰，你是诸神教义的导师，在冒险旅途中，你对平民在精神上的幸福寄予了很多的关注，恰似你献身于神罚使的事业一般。

那些你所保护的平民并不知晓你的真正身份，他们只是认为你是一个粗俗的乡下神父或是一个流浪的修道士，或许他们会认为你富有智慧和慈悲，但是却不会把你和猎杀怪物的英雄联系到一起。他们错了，不过当然，这正是你所期望的。当你回应他们在精神上的需求时，你依然警惕地注视着周围的危机：强盗和土匪、残暴的掠夺者、饥饿的怪物，卑鄙的恶棍们无时无刻不在盯着那些疏于防范的弱小生灵，所以才需要你站出来，作为牧者来令你的羊群远离凶恶。

你刻意地回避名声和荣耀，因为骄傲会令人堕落。对你来说，你更愿意把阳光下的荣誉留给与你一起冒险的伙伴，而对自己的功劳只字不提。因为你相信，所有你所做的一切都会得到回报，不过不是在此时此地，而是在另一个世界。

body:
**不速之客 Unwelcome Guest**
「Would you deny shelter to a simple entertainer?」

**前提条件：阿塔斯歌手主题**

People in the Tyr Region learn not to trust a performer blindly. An ordinary minstrel, a graceful dancer, or a honey-voiced singer might well be a killer sent by a bitter rival. Custom demands, however, that no entertainer be refused entry. The household should welcome such a guest regardless of any suspicions. Nevertheless, paranoid nobles might turn away one of these entertainers for fear of poison in their drink or a knife in their back.

Those who refuse entry to a performer do so at risk to themselves. Even if the new arrival did not have malicious intent, a refusal is an insult few performers can bear, and such an affront makes enemies where there were none before.

An unwelcome guest is a talented entertainer who uses his or her performer's status to infiltrate a target's house and get close enough to make the kill. Unwelcome guests master the use of poisons, hiding venoms and toxins about their persons for easy access when the opportunity to kill presents itself. Some unwelcome guests work alone, but many claim membership in an entertainer's troupe, an organization often rife with murderers, thieves, and saboteurs. Bards make the best unwelcome guests, but rogues, fighters, and assassins might find something in this path for themselves as well.

「I am the winter storm, the screaming blizzard, and the blinding snow.」

**前提条件：雅灵**

Nobility to the eladrin people is more than status—it is an investiture of power granted by the archfey in exchange for binding oaths and devotion. The eladrin refer to their nobles by many titles, and one traveling in their circles is bound to encounter coure, novier, firre, and others. Each title reflects a particular pact and the magical power gained as a result. The bralani are eladrin nobles who bind themselves to those archfey associated with nature, the seasons, and storms. The power they wield allows them to harness elements and make them their own.

You are a noble eladrin, having earned your greater standing through a pact made with the Winter Court. While the Winter Court expects you to serve it, the archfey rarely call in their debts. Thus you are free to pursue your own agenda as long as it is not at odds with your patron. You can harness winter's power, weaving its wild magical energy into devastating attacks. Your connection to winter triggers other changes. Your skin becomes cold to the touch, your features assume a blue hue, and the air around you holds winter's chill.

**裁决特使 Praetor Legate**
「Sometimes hard decisions must be made to further the interests of the State. The dictator trusts my judgment in these matters.」

**前提条件：执政官主题或「巫王契约」职业特性**

Through a combination of personal talent, family connections, wealth, and loyal service to Dictator Andropinis, you have won a high office among the templars of Balic. Most praetors are magistrates, overseers of commerce, or military commanders—they lack your personal might and are simply highranking officials and administrators. You, however, aren't saddled with mundane duties. Instead, you are a personal representative of the dictator, vested with the power to further the interests of the state in whatever manner you deem appropriate. As a badge of your special office, you are entitled to wear a cloak or tunic with a purple stripe or border.

As a praetor legate, you might spy on Balic's enemies, investigate corruption, look after the defense of the life-sustaining trade routes throughout the Forked Tongue, track down criminals, or search for ancient artifacts in ruined cities. You answer only to Andropinis himself……and if you are a true patriot, you might find that the interests of the dictator and the interests of Balic are not always one and the same.

Balic is friendlier to trade than any other city in the Tyr Region is, and several important merchant houses are based here. Consequently, praetors find that their duties often lead them to distant villages and even other cities, watching over Balic's trade affairs. Most praetor legates are natives of Balic, but capable and trustworthy foreigners occasionally rise high in the ranks of Andropinis's templars.

title: 彩龙灾星 Chromatic Bane
body:
**彩龙灾星 Chromatic Bane**
「Gold, red, puce, doesn't matter one copper to me. All I care about is whether or not you serve the Chromatic Dragon. This is one thing I just can't stand.」

**前提条件：任意神术职业**

The titanic struggle between Bahamut and Tiamat is legendary. Throughout history, the two gods have clashed, their armies mustering and throwing themselves against each other repeatedly as the two powers struggle for dominance. No matter the other interests guiding them or their involvement in the natural world, their longstanding animosity inevitably comes to the fore. Many champions fighting for the Platinum Dragon identify this endless conflict and come to see Tiamat as evil's author in the world. Those who do might take the battle to Tiamat's followers, committing themselves to rooting out and destroying her dragons and other servants.

As a Chromatic Bane, you devote your training and purpose to the destruction of evil dragons. Metallic or chromatic, planar or otherwise, if the dragon is sworn to the Lady of Avarice, it becomes your sworn enemy. You hone your fighting techniques to withstand draconic fury and develop ways to lend aid to comrades who fight at your side. When you master your style, you become Tiamat's bane, a relentless adversary opposing her designs on every front.

title: 残酷黑暗卫士 Grim Blackguard
body:
**残酷黑暗卫士 Grim Blackguard**

**前提条件：圣武士（黑暗卫士）**

You are a living embodiment of your chosen vice when you choose to be. Your powerful devotion to vice can strengthen its hold on you, allowing it to reach past the bounds you might want to place upon it. More care is required if you wish to be the one in control.

**11级：残酷黑暗卫士行动 Grim Blackguard's Action**

You usually retain control over the sinister impulses you experience, but when desperation pushes you to reach beyond your normal limits, your power over your vice can break.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的败德相关联的特性

**11级：败德力量 Vice's Strength**

The vice darkening your soul is never far from your thoughts. It lends you strength when other forces threaten to overpower you.

**增益：**你在豁免骰上获得+2加值，在对抗恐惧效果的豁免骰上获得+4加值

**11级：败德遭遇威能 Vice Encounter Power**

Combat reveals the depths to which your vice has taken hold. The temptation to draw on the darkness is great, since it offers immediate reward when your enemies assail you.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的败德相关联的遭遇攻击威能

**12级：败德辅助威能 Vice Utility Power**

Vice can lead to evil, and evil often turns on itself. The blackguards of history knew that their power must unite their allies and underlings. You have gained the ability to turn your vice into a physical manifestation that instead unifies your allies.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的败德相关联的辅助威能

**16级：黑暗祝福 Dark Blessing**

Dark devotion brings with it darker might. When an enemy falls to your onslaught, your commitment to shadow magic allows you to snatch a part of its fleeting spiritual energy and turn it to your advantage.

**增益：**当一个邻近你的生物生命值降到0时，掷一个d4来决定你获得哪一个「黑暗祝福」

1：你获得10点临时生命值

2：你在所有防御上获得+2威能加值直到你下一回合结束

3：你在攻击骰上获得+1威能加值直到你下一回合结束

4：你恢复等同于你魅力调整值的生命值

**20级：败德每日威能 Vice Daily Power**

A career spent in service to your vice leaves an indelible mark, twisting your appearance when you use your powers so that you embody your vice. Your presence afflicts your enemies with your vice's power.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的败德相关联的每日攻击威能
